name: René Repasi - Après le considérant C - Am 31
title: REPORT with recommendations to the Commission on the 28th Regime: a new legal framework for innovative companies
part_text: C a. whereas Europe’s lack of competitiveness and attractiveness stems from the significant regulatory burdens imposed on European companies under the Green Deal; ; whereas it is necessary for the Commission to pursue real simplification rather than considering harmonising all the social, fiscal and statutory rules applicable to companies;
